notes: New DCL06-C labels: every key that aurora-lint d21be1b3d (0.6.0) reports for DCL06-C at the default or strict preset in curl, mbedtls and sqlite at the pinned commits, that is in scope under data/benchmark_repos.json and is not already labeled (18 keys: curl 2, mbedtls 6, sqlite 10). This is a calibration batch, to fix the reading before the hostap and valkey populations. Each key was read at source in the pinned checkout (corpus-check clean). It was judged under rulings/rules/DCL06-C.md: the oracle labels strict (P/oracle-scope); strict is the presumption with no exempt set (DCL06-C/2026-10-07/form, /presets), so -1/0/1/2, single characters and literals assigned to a variable are not exempt here; EX1 is settled by review and applies only where the constant is itself the abstraction (two percent factors). An array dimension in a declaration is labeled FP after CERT's own sizeof compliant solution, which keeps char buffer[256]; and moves the violation to the dependent use (P/lists case 3). The dependent uses in the same function are labeled TP. Ten rows conflict with neighbouring carried-forward labels, which predate the 2026-10-07 rulings and exempted algorithm-inherent constants, comment-documented values and self-evident bit-mask idioms. Each conflict is named in that row's provenance. No prior row is edited by this batch.
